links.targetTitle: BD planning — industry and companion-software selection (20 Aug 2026)

title: Five candidate industries were listed without assessment
content:
The session listed legal, finance and accounting, logistics and transportation, government and defense, and energy and utilities, each recorded with nothing but "?".

Recording them as explicitly unassessed is more useful than omitting them: it distinguishes "considered and rejected" from "not yet examined", and it means a later reader does not have to guess whether silence implied a judgement.

Government and defense is the notable entry, since defense already appears inside the manufacturing assessment as a hard sovereignty requirement. It is listed separately and unexamined as a sector in its own right.
description: Legal, finance and accounting, logistics and transportation, government and defense, and energy and utilities each appear with only a question mark against them.
